question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

All and sundry
solution:
The correct answer is **2) Everyone without distinction.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom** "all and sundry" **is** used to refer to everyone or every single person without any exception or distinction**. It implies inclusivity, encompassing all individuals without leaving anyone out.
 
• For example:
 
 
• The announcement was made to **all and sundry**, ensuring that no one was left uninformed.
 
• The company's new policy applies to **all and sundry**, regardless of their position or seniority.
 
• In both examples, "all and sundry" is used to emphasize that the information or policy is meant for everyone, without any exceptions or exclusions.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **2) Everyone without distinction**, as it best captures the meaning of the idiom/phrase.
